market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from $100 oil and trade war escalation. US stocks drifting as inflation risk rises. Dollar weakness supports EM and commodities. Expect volatility around US-Iran developments and Canada tariff implementation. CD rates at 4.35% and high-yield savings at 4.10% attract risk-averse capital. Crypto rotating from BTC to altcoins on rate risk.
market_outlook.long_term: Commodities supercycle (copper, nuclear, oil) supports resource equities through 2027. AI infrastructure buildout (power, chips, cloud) creates multi-year capital expenditure cycle. Venezuela oil reopening adds 1-2M bpd over 3-5 years. Social Security fiscal pressure may force tax increases, supporting fiscal hedges. Trade fragmentation (US-Canada, US-China) reshapes supply chains structurally.
